name: hidx_q_r4-r4-COMMIT
purpose: HBM-C 10-17: recipe 4 re-kit of hidx_q_pr2 (successor RTL 1a7a712ce: one clock root, 5 SRAM 32x128; unit bench MUT0 PASS / MUT1,2 FAIL); hidx_q_pr gate FAIL (eh_r 17,953-load broadcast, 20-level quant stage, multi-root coverage) | idx_q successor of hidx_q_pr (7 CTS roots = 7 die entries; CTS hold repair -56.6 ps / TNS -29,474 ps on cross-entry transfers, 100 ps die-skew reserve): ONE clock root clk for every flop and SRAM (no data path between two clock entries; clk_quant/clk_quant_delay/clk_bank ports kept, unloaded), 4x8-head flop banks -> 5 SRAM 32x128, quant element line ot_hdc_delay_rf, rst -> ot_rst_relay; same ports, same latency. Clocks on the W (logic) face. Benches run_query.sh (MUT0 pass / MUT1-3 fail) + run_scheduled.sh.

bench.name: lint
bench.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN} && printf '%s\n' 'module ot_lint_top; ot_hbm_idx_query_static u_top (); endmodule' > {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv && verilator --lint-only -Wno-fatal -Wno-lint -Wno-style -Wno-TIMESCALEMOD -Wno-MULTIDRIVEN -Wno-MODMISSING -DSYNTHESIS --top-module ot_lint_top {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv rtl/hbm_accel/index/ot_hbm_idx_query_static.sv rtl/hbm_accel/index/ot_hbm_idx_actquant_owned_native.sv rtl/hdc/ot_hdc_fpu.sv rtl/hdc/ot_hdc_delay.sv rtl/hdc/ot_hdc_delay_rf.sv rtl/hdc/ot_hdc_fp32_mul_pipe.sv rtl/proto/ot_fp32_add_rne_pipe.sv rtl/lib/ot_rst_relay.sv physical/asap7_memory_macros/ot_sram_1r1w_32x128_m1/ot_sram_1r1w_32x128_m1_bb.v && echo lint-ok

calibrate.reason: ref_tile: boundary referenced in-run to the propagated tree (io_ref_skew.sdc), as the Qwen die masters

route.cmd: export OT_TTB_CORNER_MARK={CL}/ttb_corner.txt && python3 tools/closure_loop/tt_overlay.py {SRC} && export OT_CTS_FIX_HOOKS='physical/common_flow/cg_pushdown.tcl physical/common_flow/clk_net_protect.tcl physical/common_flow/link_budget_hook.tcl'; export OT_ORFS_CORNER_OVERRIDE=TC; HM=0.03 OT_MM_FF_SDC='physical/ref_tile/hidx_q_r4/signoff_ffrepair.sdc' SRC={SRC} OT_PIN_GROUP_MAX=32 bash tools/ref_tile/ref_route.sh physical/ref_tile/hidx_q_r4/kit.env {LABEL} {RUN}/routes

collect.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN}/record/route {RUN}/record/views && cp {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/corner_sta.json {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/status {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/STATUS {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/signoff.sdc {RUN}/record/route/ && python3 tools/ref_tile/ref_tile.py export --orfs-dir {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/work/orfs --kit physical/ref_tile/hidx_q_r4 --out {RUN}/record/views/ot_hbm_idx_query_static --macro-view physical/asap7_memory_macros/ot_sram_1r1w_32x128_m1 > {RUN}/record/route/export.log 2>&1
